shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone surface
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief animals in profile alongside anthropomorphic figures, organised into horizontal registers, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows isolated, schematic, disproportionate creatures (a fox-like beast, a bird-headed form, a bucranium-like row along the top) floating without a groundline, whereas B shows a naturalistic, tightly ordered procession of robed men leading fleece-textured rams above a rosette border — no specific motif, posture or relationship is shared.
